blocks.text: A home is more than just a place to clock out from the demands of everyday life. For a young professional, it can serve as a blank canvas where ideas are scattered across couches and marble tabletops, and where one gets ready to face the day, perhaps wondering: Who will I be today? It’s a question that often comes with entering a new chapter in life. For many young people, crossing the graduation stage with diploma in hand marks the beginning of a journey toward finding their place in the world.
